MEMORANDUM OFPARTICIPATION THIS MEMORANDUM OF PARTICIPATION is made effective as of May 4,2026(this "Memorandum") by and between BCC 1029 DEAN LLC,a NewYork limited liability company, York 11232 (the“Lender”), and OAKNORTH BANK PLC,a banking institution under the laws of the United Kingdom, having an address at 57 Broadwick Street, Soho, London W1F 9QS (the "Participant"). PRELIMINARYSTATEMENT WHEREAS,Lender is owner and holder of a portion of that certain construction loanwhich portion is in the aggregate amount ofup to $15,130,000.00 (the “Loan") as evidenced and/or secured, respectively, by a set of Loan documents (the “Loan Documents") affecting the leasehold premises commonly referred to as 1029 Dean Street,Brooklyn, New York 11238 (the “Premises", and as more particularly described on Exhibit A attached hereto) and made with DEAN GL LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an address at 670 Myrtle Avenue, #222, Brooklyn, New York 11205 ("Borrower"); Agreement, dated effective as of the date hereof (the“Agreement"), pursuant to which Lender agreed to confer untoParticipant a set of rights and privileges in the Loan and Loan Documents on the terms and conditions set forth in the Agreement; and WHEREAS,Participant has the right to record this Memorandum pursuant to the terms of the Agreement. NOW,THEREFORE,Lender and Participant certify as follows: 1.All capitalized terms used but not otherwise defined herein shall have the meanings ascribed to themin theAgreement. 2.The terms and conditions of the Agreement are incorporated herein as though set forth in full. 3.This Memorandum is executed for the purpose of recordation in order togive notice of the existence of the Agreement. 4.TheAgreement remains infull force and effect. 5.This Memorandum shall be governed and construed in accordance with the laws of theState of NewYork. 6.The removal/termination of this Memorandum shall only require the signature of Participant.
